name: Brahmarpanam
text:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् ।
ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना ॥
meaning: The offering is the divine, the oblation is the divine, poured by the divine into the fire that is the divine. One who sees the divine in every action reaches the divine.
purpose: A verse said before meals in many homes.
supports: Gratitude; seeing the sacred in ordinary acts.
